window.rule: Exact UTC starts use the rolling UTC interval; undated/date-only rows use the declared source-calendar window with explicit flags.

facts_policy: Only captured official-source fields. Blank = unverified. A published schedule is not proof of current match status.

assumptions.record_model: Beta(2,2) shrinkage of season W/L, followed by log5. No home advantage, player adjustment or market input.
assumptions.nhl_settlement: Match winner including overtime and shootout; binary losses = regulation losses + OT/SO losses.
assumptions.mlb_score_model: Independent Poisson final-score approximation, conditioned on unequal scores. Rates average own runs/game and opponent runs-allowed/game. No pitcher, park or postseason adjustment. NOT calibrated.
assumptions.mlb_handicaps: Fixed research lines A -1.5 and A +1.5, never selected to manufacture confidence.
assumptions.mlb_totals: Three half-run research totals centered on floor(sum of expected scores) + 0.5. These are originated lines, NOT observed bookmaker offerings.
assumptions.confidence: Low until temporal out-of-sample calibration, current market quote, and fully sourced form/player/history context are available. A high modeled chance alone does not confer high confidence.
